Mission Local found that Daniel Lurie’s campaign and its allies spent $156.14 per first-choice vote—the highest cost per vote among the mayoral candidates. London Breed’s side spent $58.86 per vote, Aaron Peskin $34.27 and Mark Farrell $85.03. Chyanne Chen’s close District 11 race had the second-most expensive vote, at $114.66 per first-choice vote.
